name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast by default for all interactive elements. This ensures keyboard users can see focus clearly even on low-contrast backgrounds, meeting WCAG AAA for focus visibility. The trade-off is slightly larger touch targets, but that benefits mobile users too—no downside.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG warns reduced motion overrides contrast requirements. Better: 3px at 4.5:1 meets focus visibility without breaking when users combine settings. Settle it: test with screen readers toggling both modes; if it fails, adopt 3px at 4.5:1.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast by default. This meets WCAG AA for focus visibility while avoiding conflicts when users toggle both reduced motion and high contrast—unlike the 4px/7:1 version, which breaks in that edge case. The trade-off is slightly smaller focus rings, but they remain clearly visible against most backgrounds and still exceed the minimum size for touch targets.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 still fails when users toggle *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG warns reduced motion overrides contrast requirements. Better: 4px at 7:1 meets WCAG AAA for focus visibility *and* passes when users combine settings. Settle it: test with screen readers toggling both modes; if it fails, use 4px/7:1 with a fallback to 3px/4.5:1 for users who prefer reduced motion.
